comments.author: @seekererebus255
comments.text: AI does an excellent job of demonstrating a reality that most creatives do not want to admit: information cannot be owned. Information is not exclusive, it can be copied infinitely. To be property, a thing must be exclusive. Also, information cannot be created, only discovered in a particular pattern. Artwork is the alteration of the pattern that is imagined or identified in the world into a different pattern that, hopefully, is considered artistically pleasing. The pattern is a transformation, not a creation. As such, artists, writers, and musicians can't own their digital work because it is by nature unownable.
